visual_identity.pattern_strategy: Disruptive Orca-style masking; stark, large white patches over eyes and running horizontally along the lower flank, highly visible across the long profile view.
visual_identity.integument: Rough, leathery shark-skin with visible battle-scarring and parasite marks detailing its massive flank.
visual_identity.facial_silhouette: Industrial-beam straight jawline; massive, exposed interlocking conical teeth even when the mouth is closed, oriented parallel to the frame edge.

pose: A strict side-profile view capturing the full horizontal mass of the apex pliosaur as it swims steadily from left to right. Its large skull, barrel chest, all four massive paddle-flippers mid-stroke, and short tapering tail are fully extended horizontally to precisely trace alongside the UI measuring tape system. Water ripples smoothly over its high-contrast black and white hide.
